name: Toes-to-Bar
cues: Hang with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders
Press the bar down toward your hips with straight arms
Lift your feet to touch the bar between your hands
Lower slowly to a still hang before the next rep

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Toes reach the bar, and the sheet reads as toes-to-bar with no visible clipping. But the pike is mostly hip: hip flex 125 with straight knees, while lumbar only reaches 16 and thorax 4. That is why thigh/trunk penetration needs 65/94 mm against a default of 15/60. Owner should decide on the override. Trying more spinal rounding (lumbar 30-40) and shoulder extension with less hip flexion might cut the overlap, and that option was not tried.
